{{Quote|The Rebels are devious, and like fanned rawls they have hidden themselves well and fashioned nests and lairs at the highest levels of power.|Inquisitor Loam Redge|<ref name="TRoD">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref>}}
'''Fanned rawls''', also known simply as '''rawls''', were [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Snake/Legends|snakes]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Giantfannedrawl-1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A giant fanned rawl on Naboo]]
Rawls were native to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Pencil" /> but they could also be found on the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="FOC prima">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Varieties included '''giant fanned rawls''', '''spitting rawls''', and '''vine rawls''', all native to Naboo.<ref name="SWG" /> A very similar snake species was the [[Shadevale stalker|shadevale venomsting]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="ROTW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

Rawls had a scaly hide.<ref name="SWG" /> The fans, located on the side of their bodies, were used for swimming.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|254|fanned rawl}}</ref> Fanned rawls had a poisonous bite<ref name="SWG" /> and were considered to be quite dangerous serpents.<ref name="Pencil" />

==History==
The powerful [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] attack of [[Spitting Rawl Technique|Spitting Rawl]] was named after the one variety of rawl.<ref name="SWG" /> [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Loam Redge]] likened the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to fanned rawls.<ref name="TRoD" /> [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] sometimes used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "rawl".<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Relan Smiff]] was awarded the Herpetology Award of the [[Galactic Science Foundation]] for his discovery of giant fanned rawls on Naboo.<ref name="Sony" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RawlConcept.jpg|200px|thumb|Fanned rawl concept from ''Pencil to Pixel'']]
Fanned rawls were creatures in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

While the vast majority of Naboo's wildlife was well-established through [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Episode I'']] and other sources, the team created a handful of new creatures for the planet, including the rawl, to fill specific niches.<ref name="Pencil" />
